objectives: Explain why the Most High respected Abel's offering and not Cain's.
Use Genesis 4 to show there were other people on the earth besides Adam's household.
Contrast the line of Cain with the line of Seth.
takeaways: Cain knew animal sacrifice was required, because the sacrificial law was ordained at Genesis 3:21; the Most High called him to repent.
Abel was a prophet, counted with the blood of the prophets (Matthew 23:35).
Every one that findeth me, the wife from Nod and the city Cain built all show the earth was already peopled.
Multiple wives and the making of weapons began with the sons of the wicked; Lamech knew thou shalt not kill was in force.
Through Seth men began to call upon the name of the Lord, so the Most High chose the line of Seth.
